## Model Answer: Managing Clients with Automation

### Support Bot FAQ Automation (bot response bank)

| Question | Bot response |
|---|---|
| How do I access my dashboard? | You can access your dashboard at [dashboard_url]. Use your login credentials to sign in. |
| How do I modify settings? | Go to Settings -> Automation Configuration. Adjust triggers, actions, and schedules. |
| How do I add a team member? | Settings -> Team Management -> Add Member. Enter their email and assign permissions. |
| How do I view reports? | Dashboard -> Reports. Filter by date range, automation type, performance metrics. |
| How do I contact support? | Email support@lane-automation.example or use the chat widget. |

**Escalation triggers:** complex technical questions, billing inquiries, feature requests, complaints.

### Ticket Routing Rules
Technical issues -> technical team. Billing questions -> billing team. Feature requests -> product/Jordan. General inquiries -> support queue. **Priority:** High = system down/billing issue. Medium = feature request/general question. Low = documentation request.

### Automated Reporting
- **Weekly performance report** — every Monday 9am, to client contacts: execution summary, performance metrics, error reports, recommendations.
- **Monthly analytics** — first Monday of month, to stakeholders: ROI analysis, usage trends, optimization opportunities.
- **Custom reports** — on client request, delivered within 24 hours.

### Feedback Collection
Monthly satisfaction survey by email: overall satisfaction rating, service quality rating, communication effectiveness, improvement suggestions. Sentiment-analyzed and turned into follow-up tasks automatically, with a personal response from Jordan to any low score.
